notes.title: Paper Bride 2 Zangling Village will be available on Steam on May 6th
notes.notes:
1.What is the price? Will there be in-app purchases?
 A: The US store is priced at $9.99,  other stores can log in to the store to check for yourself ~ There is a 10% discount for the first week of sale!
 Friends who have purchased paper bride 1 can choose to buy paper bride series bundles to enjoy 15% discount~ 
 There will be no in-app purchases and advertisements in the system version. Thank you for your love and support for the paper bride series.

2.When is the release date?
 A: It will be released globally at 10:00 on April 28th, Beijing time.
 (If there is an abnormality on the Steam platform, the sale may be delayed)

3.What are the features of the Steam version?
 A: In the fully upgraded horizontal scene, more heart-pounding details and dynamic effects have been added, and the immersive puzzle solving experience has been greatly increased; of course, there are 20 achievements we have prepared for you to challenge. Go ahead!
In addition, this time we will also  release 2 free DLCs on the steam version for the first time, which can be obtained by purchasing the game itself！Super cost-effective!

4.How many DLCs does the game have in Paper Bride 2 Zangling Village? How do I need to get it?
 A: There are two DLCs this time, original sound collection and original setting collection, which can be unlocked by purchasing the main game.
Paper Bride 2 Zangling Village Original  Setting: Contains Paper Bride 2 characters, scene-setting drafts and dozens of exquisite 4K original promotional paintings, as well as the new "Liang Zhu" wallpaper as the original promotional painting on Steam~

How to download DLC?
1. Download the game Paper Bride 2  Zangling Village on the steam platform, and the DLC will be downloaded automatically;
2. After downloading, click the main interface - settings - management - browse local files to find the downloaded DLC content in the local files;
3. The folder name is art, which contains the original setting collection and the original art collection; the file name is music, which contains the original sound collection;


5.How long is the overall game?
 A: The current full version of the game is about 3-5 hours long. (compared to the first part of the paper bride, the overall duration and difficulty have increased !Have a good time!)

6.Are there any hints for the puzzle? What should I do if the mini-game is too hard to do?
 A: It contains intimate tips, and the mini-game also has a skip function, all of which have a certain CD, please don't worry~

7.What language versions are currently available?
 A: Currently, there are simplified Chinese, traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese versions. After the first paper bride was released, many foreign friends have deeply felt the unique charm of Chinese folk culture~

8.How to obtain the Steam achievements of Zangling Village in game?
 A: Paper Bride 2 Zangling Village has a total of 20 achievements. If you clear the level without reading the tips or skipping the mini-game, you can get all the achievements at one time!(Tips in the novice guide do not affect achievements)

During the experience, if you have any questions or suggestions, you can join our discord channel to communicate~
discord：https://discord.gg/kPNcQB4FdC

Thank you again for your company and support for our paper bride games . We will try our best to bring you more surprises!
